evidence_quotes.O: This laptop is simply gorgeous. Everything about it spells workmanship, from the shiny, galssy top cover to the bright and clear screen and chiclet keyboard.
evidence_quotes.C: One hick up: it lost the route (I had to reprogram it) after I deliberately made several turns.
evidence_quotes.E: In my opinion, Canon makes the best cameras in the market. However, none of the compacts has come even close to my expectations.
evidence_quotes.A: The rest of it sucks. Especially no Netflix viewer. This should keep a bunch of potential buyers away.
evidence_quotes.N: I am so disappointed with the HK GPS-300's GPS performance becuase I like it so much.
